attributes.action: Keep the Existing 5-Year ILR Route for People Already Living in the UK
attributes.additional_details: All migrants who have arrived in the UK and have been granted legal residence should be protected by the immigration rules in place when they received their permission to stay. Any changes to settlement rules should apply only to future arrivals. People who already hold legal residence should retain their right to apply for ILR after 5 years under the rules that applied when their status was granted.
attributes.background: People already living legally in the UK should keep the right to apply for ILR after 5 years under the current rules. Any new immigration rules should only apply to future arrivals, not existing residents.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Make all visa holders eligible for ILR after 5 continuous years of residency
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771200
